title: e75 upwind-barrier cap on eddy water (declared before any e75 run is scored)
made_after: amendments 1-4 all failed (they dried the ranges with the lee). Budget diagnosis (scripts/rain_shadow_budget.py, california, r44): Nevada lee rain 1.08 mm/day fed by storm exchange 0.80, evaporation 0.65, advection 0.33, column drying -0.68; the e74c accounted cap dropped the clipped water inside the lee's own ranges (lee 1.03), windward unchanged.
mechanism: rotclimate/model.py e75: barrier = highest ground within eddy_barrier_km upwind along the eddy-scale mean wind; the eddy mixing target is capped at the column saturation at barrier height, fully where the barrier stands eddy_barrier_dz_km above the cell. Crest and windward cells are never capped. Default off; r44 byte-identical (checked by the gate's r44 rerun).
screen_rule: Same as plan.json: contrast error -25% and the three regions' mean rain loss not up by more than 2%. Every passing variant goes to the policy_v3 dev49 + fine28 gate against r44 (at most three). A gate passer goes to sealed set i only with the owner's release.
